commands.bsc.readiness.start: fixed native read-only binary; lifecycle lock; durable UUID receipt; snapshot hash identity
commands.bsc.readiness.stop: SIGTERM current managed job only; no force kill
commands.bsc.candidate.select: offline G0.7 A/B candidate request only: fixed SELF_A|SELF_B resource, profile_version generation CAS, native g07_candidate request record; effective only after the native apply at the desktop bsc sync; never arm, sign or send

missing: Readiness head block not provided by native record
source_snapshot: SHA-256 manifest of every staged file; Data as of is explicit sync time; operational result keeps its canonical relative path and source snapshot hash
command_cas: BSC resource_id is the observed launch UUID, rechecked under lifecycle lock. A new launch invalidates stale start/stop requests.

native_bindings_rules: Each census field resolves to exactly one rule: an explicit field list beats the longest matching prefix, which beats '*'. Rows inside a section keep the native schema order. EXCLUDED needs panel none.

native_bindings.reason: provider id only, never a URL
repo-relative paths only; absolute local paths are masked by safe_text
BSC-048: typed provenance of a GUI readiness result, the sync's import gate; internal metadata, the result itself is shown from its readiness record
superseded acceptance contract; V5 is the only active authority (historical bytes stay evidence, never shown as authority)
state_dir only as redacted status, never a local path (G7)
embedded copy of the bound preflight; shown from its own record and bound via evidence_inputs.preflight_sha256
